caption: I know this sounds strange but just hear me out because this one actually surprised me. 😂 Every day after my shower, a small amount of castor oil on my armpits while the skin was still damp. Thirty days. That is it. Week one the irritation and sensitivity from shaving started calming down. Week two the dark discoloration I had just accepted as normal started looking more even. Week three the ingrown hairs that always showed up after shaving were dramatically less. By week four the skin under my arms looked genuinely different — softer, more even, less angry after every shave. The ricinoleic acid works on the inflammation and discoloration at the source and keeps the hair follicle healthy enough to reduce ingrowns before they even form. Three problems, one product, one of the most neglected areas on your body.
